class: A static repo guard that decides WHICH code it checks by whether the source text contains the target's name (a URL fragment, a helper's identifier, a file-level keyword) misses every case that reaches the same target without spelling the name: a glob or regex pattern that matches it, a helper imported from another file that does the work, an alias, or a second call site in a file that already passed once (per-file instead of per-site checks).
mechanism: Chunk 3 PR 2 (#532 C1): the first cut of tests/test_e2e_live_socket_fakes.py scoped a Playwright spec as a strategy-live fake only when its routeWebSocket pattern text contained `strategies/live` and judged each FILE once (ECHO if it imported echoSeq and called `.stamp(` anywhere, SILENT if it had no `.send(`). An independent Opus check showed a spec routing `'**/live'` (which Playwright matches against /api/strategies/live) was never scanned, and a spec whose handler was imported from a support file that sent unstamped pushes was classed SILENT and passed.

first_seen.where: chunk 3 PR 2 round-1 check of build/c3-c2-order-closure head 54f933ef
first_seen.evidence: checker scratch chk2/c1attack.py: A4 (handler imported from a support file that calls ws.send without seq) -> passed the guard; A5 `'**/live'` and A5b `'**/api/strategies/*'` -> not in scope, passed; A3 one extra unstamped send in an ECHO file -> passed; A8 `.stamp(` only in a comment -> passed.

fix: Evaluate what the code would match, not what it names: translate each pattern with the framework's own glob rules and test it against the real target URL; check every call site (each send), not each file; follow helpers and aliases by import source; fail closed on a pattern or call the scan cannot evaluate. Prefer a structural guarantee (one shared helper every fake must go through) when the language allows too many shapes.

detection.note: Guarded for the instance (the Playwright live-socket fakes) only: tests/test_e2e_live_socket_fakes.py translates every routeWebSocket pattern with Playwright's glob rules and tests it against the live URL, checks every send (not every file), follows echoSeq by import source and the support files a live file imports, and fails closed on a pattern or send it cannot attribute. Mutation gate on the guard: 8 mutants killed. Out of reach: a send through a computed property built at run time, a socket whose URL cannot match the live one. Other static repo guards are not re-audited for this class; the builder-brief standing item (c) is the mechanism if it recurs.
